messages:
infra-bot: ALERT: NLB target connection-reset spike detected in euc1-azb (backend: inference-gw-prod). 5xx surge observed across multiple target groups. Pager sent to on-call.

maria_ops: Paging and triage: seeing 5xx and TLS handshakes failing. Metrics: 12k conn resets in the last 6m, error-rate ~18% for /v1/generate.

jake_oncall: I'm on it. Taking ownership — will update here. first check: is this spike localized to azb or cross-az?

sam_network: Early read shows increased SYN-ACK retransmits at the AZ border; also some DNS failovers for euc1 region reported ~2m before spike.

kim_sre: Running quick health checks -> envoy upstreams show many connections in CLOSE_WAIT. Might be idle keepalives not being cleaned.

jake_oncall: Steps: 1) Add temporary NLB target deregistration to shift traffic off AZb. 2) Rotate keepalive settings on envoy pods in azb. 3) Coordinate with cloud provider for possible hypervisor-level NIC flap.

maria_ops: Support triage: customers on euc1 see timeouts and partial responses. Raising severity to P1 for impacted customers flagged by support.

support-bot: Noted. Creating incident tickets for affected customers: INC-2026-734, INC-2026-735. Will attach request IDs and example traces.

sam_network: Quick DNS note: route53 weighted policy showed a transient routing oscillation between euc1a/euc1b/euc1c for api.redwood.example.com at ~2812345605. Might have caused burst to azb.

jake_oncall: I'm going to run traffic shift now: deregister targets from NLB target-group tg-rt-infer-euc1-azb. Command: 

```bash
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:tg-rt-infer-euc1-azb --targets Id=i-0abcd1234
```

jake_oncall: deregistration started, monitoring.

kim_sre: While that's running, increase envoy keepalive timeout to 30s on azb replicas. patching deployment: `kubectl -n prod patch deployment inference-gw --patch '...envoy keepalive...'`

maria_ops: Heads up: if we adjust keepalive we must watch connection churn and request latency. Doing gradual rollout to avoid overload on remaining AZs.

sam_network: Cloud provider reported a partial NIC reset in azb around the same window. Filing ticket with them and requesting notify on remediation progress.

jake_oncall: After target deregistration, errors dropped from 18% -> 6% in 90s. Still seeing some residual resets but lower. Rolling back to cached model variant for a subset of requests as fallback.

support-bot: Drafting customer-facing message: 

"We've detected elevated errors for requests in the euc1 region impacting a subset of customers. We are actively mitigating by shifting traffic and working with the cloud provider. Root cause investigation is in progress. Updates every 15 minutes."

product-ops: +1 to update status page and notify larger accounts. Include mitigation notes and ETA for next update.

sam_network: Provider response: "We observed a NIC-level interface flapping on a host pool affecting networking for a subset of instances. We've quarantined the host and are investigating."

kim_sre: For guardrail, enabling circuit-breaker on envoy route for high-error endpoints to prevent cascading failures. Patch applied to prod with canary traffic.

jake_oncall: Can we get a check on conntrack on remaining nodes to ensure we aren't hitting table exhaustion? Running: `sudo conntrack -S` -> counters look fine, no major drop.

maria_ops: Logs: example traceroute and error snippet from a failed request: 

```
[2026-03-15T12:34:21Z] ERROR connection_reset peer=10.0.45.12:443 tls_handshake_fail count=42
[2026-03-15T12:34:22Z] WARN upstream_close code=504 idle_timeout
```

jake_oncall: Results: after removing azb targets and envoys updated, overall 5xx rate back down to ~1.2% in euc1. Cloud provider replaced the host and reattached healthy instances; we are gradually re-registering targets after verifying stability.

kim_sre: Recommend post-incident: 1) add NLB healthcheck tweaks to detect NIC-level flaps faster, 2) add route53 stabilization guard to avoid oscillatory weighted shifts on noisy metrics, 3) update runbook with conntrack and envoy keepalive knobs.

maria_ops: Agreed. Also recommend adding a synthetic traffic probe pinned to each AZ to detect localized regressions.

support-bot: Customer updates sent for INC-2026-734 and INC-2026-735. They acknowledged.

jake_oncall: Handing off to kim_sre for postmortem writeup and follow-up. I'll remain available but marking on-call handoff complete.

kim_sre: Taking postmortem ownership. Setting task list: gather packet captures, provider logs, route53 change history, envoys' keepalive histories, and all deploys in the hour window. Scheduling postmortem doc and RCA by EOD.

maria_ops: Final status: mitigation complete, partial customer impact resolved, monitoring for 2 hours. Resolved in slack with incident ticket: INCIDENT-2026-489.

infra-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: NLB connreset surge euc1-azb — mitigation: target deregistration + envoy keepalive + cloud provider host replacement. Follow-up: RCA doc assigned to kim_sre.

product-ops: Thanks team. Please link the runbook edits and postmortem once ready. :thumbsup:
